performance.verdict: Ads never launched; 5 overdue milestones now block all paid revenue.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages all missed July 31 deadline — 30+ days overdue with no completion event recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting both missed August 1 deadline — zero spend across all 28 days confirms neither channel has gone live.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 4 consecutive days (Aug 26–29); 3-day signal (0+0+0) vs prior 3 (2+0+0) confirms a sustained stall, not a one-day blip.
GHL shows 110 contacts and 16 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won deals — leads are entering the pipeline but no intake conversion is occurring.

suggestions.text: Escalate Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages to Nacer immediately — all 30+ days overdue.
suggestions.monday_update: Three milestones due July 31 — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site & Landing Pages Live — have no recorded completion event as of Aug 30, 30+ days overdue. These are sequential blockers: ads cannot launch until the site is live, pixels are firing, and LSA verification clears. Nacer to confirm status and set a hard completion date by Sep 2. Success check: all three marked complete in the SOW tracker before any ad spend is activated.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 16 opportunities, 0 appointments booked — identify where intake is dropping contacts before ads launch adds volume.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 110 contacts and 16 created opportunities but zero appointments and zero won deals, meaning leads are entering but not converting through intake. Before paid traffic is turned on, identify which pipeline stage contacts are stalling in and confirm that routing, auto-reply, and calendar booking are functional per the SOW. Success check: at least 1 test lead flows end-to-end into a booked appointment by Sep 5.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP daily actions through Sep 2; 4-day zero streak may indicate listing issue requiring profile audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 4 consecutive days (Aug 26–29), down from a 28-day total of 76 actions including 14 calls. This may reflect a listing suppression, a category or ownership issue, or simply a lull — but a 4-day zero streak warrants a manual profile check. Re-check on Sep 2; if actions remain at zero, escalate to a GBP listing audit. Success check: daily GBP actions return to a non-zero reading by Sep 2.
